_comment: R0 SEED consumer-remedy registry per ADR-2605312500 §2 — NOW WORLDWIDE (multi-jurisdiction). Originally JP-only; expanded 2026-06-02 to worldwide coverage across 4 blocs (US federal+CA/NY/TX · EU + DE/FR · UK-CW: UK/Canada-Ontario/Australia/India/Singapore · INTL-ROW: Brazil/Mexico/South Korea + international econsumer.gov/ICPEN). Each entry is the coded remedy kind / 根拠法令 (statutory or scheme basis) / statutory window (日数, where one exists) / 書面 form / delivery channel / escalation forum so kurashimori can diagnose + (eventually) help draft procedurally. ALL entries ship verificationStatus=unverified-seed: per G14, NO live send may occur against an unverified entry — these MUST be human/Council-verified (and re-checked within the freshness window) before kurashimori_send will transmit, and 代行 (R3) additionally requires council-verified + 司法書士法/行政書士法 clearance + Council Lv7+ (G15). CRITICAL: statutory cooling-off / withdrawal windows (日数) drift and vary by transaction type and jurisdiction — a wrong 日数 is harmful; these are best-effort references as of 2026-06-02 and MUST be verified against the cited official source before any live use. The cooling-off eligibility output is an INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion (G5). Boundary holds in every jurisdiction — 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL (and national analogs: German RDG, French monopole de l'avocat, Advocates Act 1961, Legal Profession Act, Law Society Act): self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: 訪問販売 クーリングオフ
targets.windowStart: 法定書面 (契約書面) を受領した日から起算 (受領日を1日目)
targets.deliveryChannel: 書面 (内容証明郵便推奨) または電子 (特商法改正で電磁的記録可)
targets.escalationForum: 消費生活センター / 消費者ホットライン 188
targets.legalBasis: 特定商取引法 §9 (訪問販売の申込みの撤回等)
targets.notes: 訪問販売は法定書面受領日から8日間 (特商法 §9)。期間内に書面/電子で通知すれば無条件解除。起算日・適用除外 (使用済消耗品等) は要確認。kurashimori は日数計算 + 通知書起草補助に限定 (G5 — 法的助言ではない)。

targets.title: 連鎖販売取引 クーリングオフ
targets.windowStart: 法定書面受領日 または 最初の商品受領日のいずれか遅い日から起算
targets.deliveryChannel: 書面 (内容証明郵便推奨) または電子
targets.escalationForum: 消費生活センター / 消費者ホットライン 188
targets.legalBasis: 特定商取引法 §40 (連鎖販売契約の解除)
targets.notes: 連鎖販売 (マルチ商法) は20日間 (特商法 §40)。起算日は書面受領日と初回商品受領日の遅い方。中途解約・返品ルールは別途。要確認。

targets.title: 通信販売 返品 (返品特約)
targets.windowStart: 商品引渡日から起算 (返品特約がない場合の法定ルール)
targets.deliveryChannel: 事業者の定める返品手続 (特約優先) / 書面通知
targets.escalationForum: 消費生活センター / 消費者ホットライン 188
targets.legalBasis: 特定商取引法 §15の3 (通信販売の契約の解除等)
targets.notes: 通信販売にクーリングオフ制度はない。事業者の返品特約が優先され、特約の表示がない場合に限り商品引渡日から8日間返品可 (特商法 §15の3、送料は消費者負担)。広告の返品特約表示を必ず確認 — 誤案内防止 (G8)。

targets.deliveryChannel: 電話 188 / 各自治体 消費生活センター 窓口

targets.title: FTC Cooling-Off Rule — 3-day right to cancel home/off-premises sales (Cooling-Off Rule / 訪問販売クーリングオフ)
targets.windowStart: Midnight of the 3rd BUSINESS DAY after the qualifying sale (business days only; many exclusions)
targets.deliveryChannel: Written cancellation notice to the seller within the window
targets.escalationForum: U.S. Federal Trade Commission complaint portal https://reportfraud.ftc.gov
targets.legalBasis: FTC Trade Regulation Rule Concerning Cooling-Off Period for Sales Made at Homes or at Certain Other Locations, 16 CFR Part 429 (esp. § 429.1)
targets.notes: Authority: U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Bureau of Consumer Protection. Consumer guide: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/buyers-remorse-ftcs-cooling-rule-may-help. Gives buyer until midnight of the 3rd BUSINESS DAY to cancel certain sales of $25+ made at home/workplace/dorm or seller's temporary location (hotel, fairground, etc.). Counting business days is arithmetic, NOT a legal opinion on whether a given sale qualifies (many exclusions: real estate, insurance, sales made entirely by mail/phone, under $25, at seller's permanent place of business). Drift: dollar threshold and covered-location definitions have been amended over time; confirm current text on eCFR before relying. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for routing/wayfinding; not for live use. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: FTC Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule — 30-day shipment / prompt-refund (Mail Order Rule / 通信販売発送・返金ルール)
targets.windowStart: Seller must ship within the advertised time or, if none stated, within 30 days; refund within 7 working days once the right vests (or one billing cycle for credit-card sales)
targets.deliveryChannel: Demand letter to the seller
targets.escalationForum: U.S. Federal Trade Commission complaint portal https://reportfraud.ftc.gov
targets.legalBasis: Mail, Internet, or Telephone Order Merchandise Rule, 16 CFR Part 435 (esp. § 435.2)
targets.notes: Authority: U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC), Bureau of Consumer Protection. Rule text: https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/rules/mail-internet-or-telephone-order-merchandise-rule. For mail/internet/phone orders, seller must ship within the advertised time or, if none stated, within 30 days; otherwise must obtain buyer consent to delay or issue a prompt refund (refund within 7 working days once the right vests, or one billing cycle for credit-card sales). NOTE: this is a distance-selling SHIPMENT/refund rule — it is NOT a general 'change of mind' return right; US has no blanket federal distance-selling withdrawal window like the EU. Retailer return policies are contractual, not statutory. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for routing/wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: Fair Credit Billing Act — credit-card billing-error dispute / chargeback (FCBA / クレジット請求エラー異議)
targets.windowStart: Issuer must RECEIVE the written billing-error notice within 60 days after the first statement showing the error
targets.deliveryChannel: Written billing-error notice mailed to card issuer's billing-inquiries address
targets.escalationForum: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau complaint https://www.consumerfinance.gov/complaint/
targets.legalBasis: Fair Credit Billing Act, 15 U.S.C. §§ 1666–1666j (Truth in Lending Act amendment); implemented by Regulation Z, 12 CFR § 1026.13
targets.notes: Authority: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) — implementing Regulation Z; card issuer handles the dispute. For OPEN-END credit (credit cards): mail a written billing-error notice so the issuer RECEIVES it within 60 days after the first statement showing the error. Issuer must acknowledge within 30 days and resolve within two billing cycles (max 90 days); disputed amount need not be paid and credit rating cannot be threatened during investigation. Separate from network 'chargeback' timelines (Visa/Mastercard rules) and from debit-card disputes (those fall under EFTA/Reg E, different deadlines). The 60-day window is INFORMATIONAL arithmetic, NOT legal advice on whether an item is a qualifying 'billing error.' UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act — federal consumer-product warranty enforcement (MMWA / 連邦保証法)
targets.windowStart: (per the written warranty's stated term; no statutory fixed window)
targets.deliveryChannel: Warrantor's stated informal dispute-settlement (IDS) process / demand submission
targets.escalationForum: Warrantor IDS (mediation/arbitration); courts for private enforcement
targets.legalBasis: Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act, 15 U.S.C. §§ 2301–2312; FTC IDS rule 16 CFR Part 703
targets.notes: Authority: U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) — rulemaking/enforcement; private enforcement via courts and warrantor informal dispute settlement (IDS). Statute index: https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/statutes/magnuson-moss-warranty-federal-trade-commission-improvements-act. Governs written warranties on consumer products costing more than the regulatory threshold; requires clear disclosure and lets consumers use the warrantor's informal dispute-settlement (mediation/arbitration) procedure and, where applicable, sue (attorney-fee shifting possible). Does NOT require a product to carry a warranty. A 'full' vs 'limited' warranty designation has specific statutory meaning. Drift: dollar thresholds in FTC rules; many disputes overlap with state lemon/warranty law (see CA entry). UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: California Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act (Lemon Law) + DCA arbitration (Song-Beverly / カリフォルニア・レモン法)
targets.windowStart: Tanner Act presumption generally applies within first 18 months / 18,000 miles given specified repair attempts
targets.deliveryChannel: State-certified arbitration intake via California DCA Arbitration Certification Program
targets.escalationForum: California DCA Arbitration Certification Program (tel 800-952-5210); courts
targets.legalBasis: Song-Beverly Consumer Warranty Act, Cal. Civ. Code §§ 1790–1795.8; Tanner Consumer Protection Act presumption at Cal. Civ. Code § 1793.22
targets.notes: Authority: California Department of Consumer Affairs (DCA) — Arbitration Certification Program (https://www.dca.ca.gov/acp/); CA Attorney General consumer info (https://oag.ca.gov/consumers/general/lemon). California state lemon law: if a manufacturer/authorized dealer cannot repair a new vehicle to warranty after a reasonable number of attempts, consumer may get replacement or refund. Tanner Act presumption (§ 1793.22) generally applies within first 18 months/18,000 miles given specified repair attempts. State-certified arbitration via DCA is an escalation forum before court. REPRESENTATIVE STATE EXAMPLE — other states have different lemon laws/thresholds. Drift: CA amended lemon-law procedures (notice/arbitration prerequisites) recently — confirm current statute/DCA process. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: New York Door-to-Door Sales 3-day cancellation + NYS Consumer Protection complaint (NY cooling-off / ニューヨーク訪問販売解約)
targets.windowStart: Cancellation until midnight of the 3rd business day via written notice to the seller
targets.deliveryChannel: Written cancellation notice to the seller within the window
targets.escalationForum: NYS Division of Consumer Protection complaint (tel 800-697-1220); NYS Attorney General Bureau of Consumer Frauds & Protection
targets.legalBasis: NY Personal Property Law Article 10-A, Door-to-Door Sales Act (§§ 425–431) — cancellation until midnight of the 3rd business day; deceptive-practices backstop NY Gen. Bus. Law § 349
targets.notes: Authority: New York State Division of Consumer Protection (DCP, https://dos.ny.gov/consumer-protection) / NYS Attorney General Bureau of Consumer Frauds & Protection (https://ag.ny.gov/consumer-frauds). New York permits cancellation of a covered door-to-door (home-solicitation) sale until midnight of the 3rd business day via written notice to the seller, paralleling the federal rule. CITATION CAVEAT: the NY door-to-door cancellation statute sits in Personal Property Law Art. 10-A (§§ 425 et seq.) — do NOT confuse with Gen. Bus. Law § 396-m, which governs MAIL/TELEPHONE-order merchandise; verify exact section + current numbering before relying (confidence:medium for the precise section). REPRESENTATIVE STATE EXAMPLE. Date computation is INFORMATIONAL arithmetic, not a legal opinion on coverage. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: Texas Deceptive Trade Practices Act complaint + 60-day pre-suit notice (DTPA / テキサス欺瞞的取引行為法)
targets.windowStart: Consumer must give the seller WRITTEN notice at least 60 days before filing a DTPA suit (§ 17.505)
targets.deliveryChannel: Written § 17.505 pre-suit notice to the seller; AG online complaint portal
targets.escalationForum: Office of the Texas Attorney General — Consumer Protection Division complaint portal
targets.legalBasis: Texas Deceptive Trade Practices-Consumer Protection Act, Tex. Bus. & Com. Code §§ 17.41–17.63 (laundry-list of unlawful acts at § 17.46; 60-day pre-suit written notice at § 17.505)
targets.notes: Authority: Office of the Texas Attorney General — Consumer Protection Division. Complaint portal: https://consumerprotection.texasattorneygeneral.gov/consumercomplaintportal/s/. Texas DTPA prohibits false/misleading/deceptive practices (§ 17.46 'laundry list'); a consumer must give the seller WRITTEN notice of the complaint and amount of damages at least 60 days before filing a DTPA suit (§ 17.505), and may recover economic damages plus up to treble damages for a knowing/intentional violation. The AG portal is the official complaint intake; the AG enforces in the public interest and does not act as the individual's private lawyer. REPRESENTATIVE STATE EXAMPLE. The 60-day pre-suit notice is INFORMATIONAL deadline arithmetic, not advice on whether a claim is viable. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for wayfinding only. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: EU 14-day right of withdrawal for distance & off-premises contracts (Right of withdrawal / Widerrufsrecht / Droit de rétractation)
targets.windowStart: 14 calendar days: for goods, from physical possession; for services, from contract conclusion (Art. 9); +12 months if trader failed to inform (Art. 10)
targets.deliveryChannel: Withdrawal notice to trader (Annex I(B) model form or any unequivocal statement)
targets.escalationForum: National consumer authority / national ADR body / ECC-Net for cross-border
targets.legalBasis: Directive 2011/83/EU on Consumer Rights (Consumer Rights Directive), Articles 9–16 (esp. Art. 9 = 14-day period; Art. 11 = exercise; Art. 13–14 = refund/return; Art. 10 = 12-month extension if trader failed to inform; Art. 16 = exceptions)
targets.notes: Authority: European Commission, DG Justice and Consumers (transposed and enforced by each Member State's consumer authority). Guide: https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/consumer-protection-law/consumer-contract-law/consumer-rights-directive_en. Window is 14 calendar days: for goods, from the day the consumer/third party acquires physical possession; for services, from contract conclusion (Art. 9). If the trader never disclosed the withdrawal right, the period extends by up to 12 months (Art. 10). Key exceptions in Art. 16: custom/personalised goods, sealed health/hygiene goods once unsealed, perishables, dated accommodation/transport, fully-performed services the consumer expressly requested. A real deadline turns on disclosure facts and exception triggers we cannot adjudicate. DRIFT WARNING: Directive (EU) 2023/2673 adds a mandatory 'cancel my contract' withdrawal function from ~June 2026; verify the as-applicable national transposition. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold for routing/wayfinding — not for live use. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: EU minimum 2-year legal guarantee of conformity (repair/replace/refund) (Legal guarantee / Gewährleistung / Garantie légale de conformité)
targets.windowStart: Seller liable for non-conformity present at delivery that appears within at least 2 years; burden-of-proof reversal for first ≥1 year
targets.deliveryChannel: Claim asserted directly to the seller (not the manufacturer)
targets.escalationForum: National consumer authority / national ADR body / ECC-Net for cross-border
targets.legalBasis: Directive (EU) 2019/771 on contracts for the sale of goods, Articles 10–14 (Art. 10 = liability for non-conformity apparent within ≥2 years; Art. 11 = burden-of-proof reversal for first ≥1 year; Art. 13–14 = hierarchy of remedies: repair/replacement then price reduction/termination). Repealed Directive 1999/44/EC; applies from 1 Jan 2022.
targets.notes: Authority: European Commission, DG Justice and Consumers (transposed into national civil/consumer codes; enforced per Member State). Guide: https://commission.europa.eu/law/law-topic/consumer-protection-law/consumer-contract-law/consumer-sales-and-guarantees_en. Distinct from the voluntary commercial warranty (Art. 17): the legal guarantee is mandatory and free. Seller liable for defects present at delivery that appear within at least 2 years; during at least the first year the defect is presumed pre-existing (seller bears burden). Member States may set longer periods (e.g., France's presomption runs 24 months; some states allow longer guarantee terms) — verify the specific national transposition before relying on a deadline. Conformity, the remedy hierarchy and time-limits are fact-specific. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold — not for live use. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.title: European Consumer Centres Network — free cross-border complaint assistance (ECC-Net / Netzwerk der Europäischen Verbraucherzentren / Réseau des Centres Européens des Consommateurs)
targets.windowStart: (随時 / on demand — cross-border consumer↔trader disputes)
targets.deliveryChannel: File with the ECC in your country of residence
targets.escalationForum: European Consumer Centres Network (ECC-Net); national ADR body / courts for binding outcomes
targets.legalBasis: ECC-Net operates under the EU Single Market Programme (Regulation (EU) 2021/690); it provides information and amicable-resolution assistance, it is not itself a statutory adjudicator
targets.notes: Authority: European Consumer Centres Network (ECC-Net), co-funded by the European Commission; one centre per EU Member State plus Norway & Iceland. Portal: https://www.eccnet.eu/ (Germany: https://www.evz.de/ ; France: https://www.europe-consommateurs.eu/). Use when the consumer and trader are in DIFFERENT EU/EEA countries (incl. Norway, Iceland; UK handled for legacy/cross-border). Free; ~24 languages. ECC-Net advises and mediates — it cannot compel a trader or issue binding decisions; for binding outcomes use a national ADR body or the courts. This is wayfinding/triage, NOT a legal opinion. targets.title: EU national Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) bodies for consumer disputes (Consumer ADR / Verbraucherschlichtung / Médiation de la consommation)
targets.windowStart: (随時 / on demand — contractual consumer disputes)
targets.deliveryChannel: Apply to a Member-State-certified ADR body via the Commission directory
targets.escalationForum: Member-State-certified consumer ADR/mediation entities; courts for binding outcomes
targets.legalBasis: Directive 2013/11/EU on consumer ADR (Consumer ADR Directive) — guarantees access to quality-assured out-of-court dispute resolution for contractual disputes
targets.notes: Authority: Member-State-certified consumer ADR/mediation entities, listed and supervised by national competent authorities and the European Commission. Directory: https://consumer-redress.ec.europa.eu/dispute-resolution-bodies_en. DRIFT WARNING (CRITICAL): the EU-level Online Dispute Resolution (ODR) platform established by Regulation (EU) 524/2013 STOPPED accepting complaints on 20 March 2025 and the ODR Regulation was repealed effective 20 July 2025 by Regulation (EU) 2024/3228. Do NOT route members to the old ec.europa.eu/consumers/odr platform. National sector ADR bodies under Directive 2013/11/EU remain available; use the Commission's certified-bodies directory. ADR participation by traders is often voluntary; outcomes may be non-binding depending on the body. This is triage/wayfinding, NOT a legal opinion. targets.title: Germany — 14-day Widerrufsrecht for distance/off-premises consumer contracts (Widerrufsrecht im Fernabsatz)
targets.windowStart: 14-day period under §355 BGB; if trader failed to give proper instruction, extends to 12 months + 14 days (§356 Abs. 3 BGB)
targets.deliveryChannel: Withdrawal declaration (Widerruf) to the trader; model form per Art. 246a EGBGB
targets.escalationForum: German civil courts / Verbraucherschlichtung (Universalschlichtungsstelle / sector body)
targets.legalBasis: Bürgerliches Gesetzbuch (BGB) §312g (Widerrufsrecht) and §355 (Widerrufsrecht bei Verbraucherverträgen); information duties under Art. 246a EGBGB — German transposition of Directive 2011/83/EU
targets.notes: Authority: German civil law (Bundesgesetz); enforced via the seller and, if disputed, German civil courts / Verbraucherschlichtung. Statute: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__312g.html. 14-day period under §355 BGB; if the trader failed to give proper withdrawal instruction, the period extends to 12 months + 14 days (§356 Abs. 3 BGB). Exceptions in §312g Abs. 2 BGB (e.g., custom goods, unsealed hygiene goods, perishables). The running of the deadline depends on disclosure and goods type. German RDG (Rechtsdienstleistungsgesetz) analog applies. UNVERIFIED SEED scaffold — not for live use. 弁護士法 / 司法書士法 / UPL: self-help diagnosis + drafting-assist only. Cooling-off windows are INFORMATIONAL date computation, NOT a legal opinion. No representation, no claims-buying, no fees.

targets.deliveryChannel: Application to Universalschlichtungsstelle des Bundes (Kehl)
targets.escalationForum: Universalschlichtungsstelle des Bundes — Zentrum für Schlichtung e. V. (Kehl); courts for binding outcomes

targets.notes: Authority: Universalschlichtungsstelle des Bundes — Zentrum für Schlichtung e. V. (Kehl), the national residual consumer ADR body. 'Residual' / Auffang body — competent only where no sector-specific consumer Schlichtungsstelle (e.g., for energy, telecoms, banking, travel) applies; check the sector body first. Handles disputes between consumers resident in the EU/Iceland/Liechtenstein/Norway and traders based in Germany. Generally free for consumers. Trader participation is often voluntary; the conciliation proposal is non-binding unless accepted. This is wayfinding, NOT a legal opinion. German RDG analog applies. targets.title: France — 14-day right of withdrawal for distance/off-premises contracts (Droit de rétractation à distance)
targets.windowStart: 14-day délai under L221-18: for goods, from receipt; for services, from contract conclusion; extends up to 12 months (L221-20) if trader omitted withdrawal info
targets.deliveryChannel: Model form (annexe to art. R221-1) or any clear declaration to the trader
targets.escalationForum: French courts / médiation de la consommation; DGCCRF oversight
targets.legalBasis: Code de la consommation, Articles L221-18 à L221-28 (esp. L221-18 = 14-day period; L221-20 = extension to 12 months if trader failed to inform; L221-23 à L221-25 = return costs; L221-28 = exceptions) — French transposition of Directive 2011/83/EU
targets.notes: Authority: French consumer law (Code de la consommation); enforced via the seller and, if disputed, French courts / médiation de la consommation; oversight by DGCCRF.
